metadata.coverage_note: This map shows facilities with a parsed inspection over 35 red points in the default recent window. Locations come from facility addresses shown in TPCHD inspection records. Each point represents one TPCHD facility/license record. If TPCHD lists multiple licensed food operations at the same address, they may appear as separate points.
metadata.data_universe: Scraper-observed TPCHD Accela food-facility inspection records with parsed PDF reports and facility inspection-history pages; this public evergreen layer is one mapped point per facility.
metadata.freshness_note: Generated from the latest TPCHD scraper/publication run.
metadata.geometry_precision: facility address from TPCHD inspection records
metadata.map_cannot_show: This map does not include source records not yet collected by the scraper.
metadata.map_claim: Shows facilities with a parsed inspection over 35 red points, with latest observed TPCHD result/status and timeline context where available.

privacy.review: Exact restaurant locations are public commercial facility addresses from public inspection records.

metadata.source_note: Tacoma-Pierce County Health Department inspection reports.

symbology.note: Evergreen markers use latest TPCHD result/action status as the color, shape and letter encoding. Red-point totals appear in the selected restaurant details when available. Alert/run maps are static per-alert layers and use fixed red-point classes.
